result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, with clear hierarchy and consistent cards. The most visible defect is an untranslated i18n key shown as a section heading. A minor contrast concern appears in the light gray secondary text and inactive tab labels. Clipped carousel items and the partially visible bottom card were excluded as intended features.

issues.description: The section heading above the popular restaurants list displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated human-readable text.
issues.suggestion: Verify the translation file contains a value for 'home_feed.popular_title' and that the i18n library is resolving it correctly before rendering, or add a fallback label such as 'Popular near you'.

issues.description: Secondary gray text (search placeholder, delivery fee and time metadata, inactive bottom navigation labels) appears light against white or light gray backgrounds, which may fall below recommended WCAG contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive tab colors to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their backgrounds.
